problem.title: Minimum Swaps to Sort by Digit Sum
hints: First, sort the array based on digit sum (and value as a tiebreaker). Then, map each original value to its index in the sorted array.
Now, the problem reduces to finding the minimum number of swaps to sort this mapped array. The answer is n - number_of_cycles in the permutation.
